sources.retrieval: Open the official announcement, then attachment 3. A temporary local copy may be used for verification and must not be committed.

accounting_and_comparability.framework: MFRS Accounting Standards and IFRS Accounting Standards, as stated in the independent auditor's report
accounting_and_comparability.unit_policy: Primary statements use RM'000; the five-year summary uses RM million; ratios are percentages.
accounting_and_comparability.period_policy: Income facts cover the calendar financial year ended 31 December. Balance-sheet and capital/liquidity ratios are reporting-date facts at 31 December.
accounting_and_comparability.restatement_caveat: The five-year summary labels FY2022 restated for MFRS 17. FY2024 primary-statement comparatives used here are not labelled restated. FY2024 business-segment figures elsewhere in the report were restated for a 2025 structural change; this fixture does not use segment figures.
accounting_and_comparability.gap_status: No gap for the FY2025/FY2024 comparison. No quarterly or pre-FY2024 detail is inferred.
